answer: Quarterly in-person meetups stop Sybils. First, each operator attends a local meetup every ninety days and signs in with a code. Second, two members check the face and stamp the visit, so one person cannot cover many. Third, a miss freezes paid work, and two misses forfeit a $30 bond. Fourth, groups rotate yearly, so farms cannot staff one friendly circle. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 travellers and $90,000 in travel and bonds, lost if caught. Trust stands like basalt against a rising tide, while a zephyr of fakes blows away, like a market where every seller shows up in person.
